verdict.rationale: The Delaware Division of Revenue is a government tax filing, payment and licensing portal, not an AI assistant or agent host. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external tool servers is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI or agent runtime that could consume MCP tools, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
